To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the plasma solid interface is extremely complex and a full understanding is presently not feasible; (ii) the plasma solid interaction can be studied with a combination of different theoretical methods; (iii) each of the methods has its own strengths and limitations and can provide complementary information about the interface processes.

the physical processes of plasma solid interaction are complex and that the plasma solid interface can only be described by coupled plasma solid simulations that include the relevant processes in the plasma and in the solid and at the interface.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new generation of plasma surface interaction simulations.

the development of a coupled modeling approach of the plasma solid interaction that will allow us to predict the behavior of the plasma solid system and to understand the underlying processes in detail.

the development of an integrated approach to the modeling of the plasma-solid interface that is able to treat the relevant physical processes in the plasma and the solid, as well as their mutual interactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a complete and accurate theoretical description of the processes at plasma solid interfaces is not yet available.
a comprehensive and detailed simulation of the processes at a plasma solid interface cannot be performed at present, due to the lack of suitable methods.
a coupled plasma solid simulation approach is necessary and that the four methods discussed in this paper have the potential to contribute to such a simulation approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to describe the plasma solid interface in a more comprehensive way than it is presently possible.
the plasma solid interface is a very complex system that can be described only with a combination of different theoretical methods.
we are still at the beginning of a long way towards an integrated modeling of plasma solid interactions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a complete picture of plasma solid interaction is not possible with a single theoretical method.
the development of a predictive theory for plasma solid interactions requires an interdisciplinary approach and the combination of several methods.
, presently, there is no method that is able to treat the complex physics at the plasma solid interface on all relevant length and time scales and with sufficient accuracy.
